result.topic_en: Transformation of bilinear forms axx'+bx'y+b'xy'+cyy' by substitutions x=-u, y=t+mu, with proper and improper equivalence of coefficient triples, followed by numerical calculations with Gaussian complex integers (a+bi) and their norms.

methods.what: Substitution x=-u, y=t+m'u transforming the bilinear form axx'+bx'y+b'xy'+cyy' into a new form in t,u
Transformation of axx'+bxy'+b'x'y+cyy' by x=-u, y=t+mu, x'=-u', y'=t'+m'u'
Proper and improper equivalence of coefficient triples of forms
Computation of norms of Gaussian integers (e.g. N(1-2i)=5, N(4)=16, N(3-2i)=13, N(-7i)=49, N(-3-5i)=34)
